title: Three legs, ii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The pup can't get up on the end stool. He tries four times in four panels. Gully builds a step out of a bait crate. Nobody says anything.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD on the end stool. BARNABY II, ten months, at the stool's foot, gathering himself. GULLY behind the counter.

image.prompt: a thin man on a shop stool with a small three-legged puppy at its foot gathering itself to jump, a man in an apron behind the counter, razor-sharp ink, no words

panels.composition: The jump. Short. The pup's front paws on the rung, the rest of him not.

image.prompt: a small three-legged puppy mid-jump with its front paws on a stool rung and its body hanging, no words

panels.composition: Gully coming around the counter with a bait crate. Setting it beside the stool. Going back. Not looking at anyone.

characters.pose: setting down a crate, not looking

image.prompt: a stocky man in an apron setting a wooden bait crate beside a stool and walking back without looking at anyone, no words

panels.composition: The pup on the crate. Then the stool. Then Wood's lap. Wood drawing, not looking down. Gully wiping the counter, not looking up.

image.prompt: a small three-legged dog settled in a thin man's lap on a shop stool with a crate beside it, the man drawing without looking down and a man in an apron wiping the counter without looking up, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk
